import { AlertTriangle, ArrowLeft, ArrowUpRight, Clock, Database, FileCheck, FileText, Layers, Table } from "lucide-react"; import { Link } from "react-router-dom"; const getSectionTag = (label: string) => `// ${label}`; const compliancePersonas = [ { role: "Global QA & Food Safety Director", context: "Oversees 200+ ingredient suppliers across North America and Europe.", need: "High-level risk heatmaps, supplier compliance rates, and automated audit status reporting." }, { role: "Facility Compliance Officer", context: "Receives raw bulk shipments daily at local manufacturing plants.", need: "Instant validation of supplier COAs (Certificates of Analysis) and rapid non-conformance logging." }, { role: "Third-Party Food Safety Auditor", context: "Performs annual on-site inspections against GFSI, SQF, and HACCP standards.", need: "Standardized audit item checklist, evidence upload vault, and non-compliance dispute logging." } ]; const complianceWorkflows = [ { step: "01", title: "Supplier Onboarding & Risk Tiering", detail: "Suppliers register certifications (GFSI, ISO 22000, Organic). System automatically assigns an initial risk score based on country of origin and ingredient allergen tier." }, { step: "02", title: "Continuous Certificate Tracking", detail: "Automated cron workers monitor expiration windows at 90, 60, and 30-day thresholds, notifying supplier portals before certifications expire." }, { step: "03", title: "Audit Non-Conformance Logging", detail: "During quarterly audits, discovered discrepancies are flagged with photographic evidence and linked directly to corrective action timelines." }, { step: "04", title: "Unified Query & Dispute Resolution", detail: "Suppliers and enterprise QA collaborate within a unified ticket thread, maintaining an immutable audit log for regulatory inspections." } ]; const erpModules = [ { title: "Supplier Compliance Radar", description: "A high-density table view with instant multi-facet filtering (by allergen risk, audit score, country of origin, and renewal urgency) replacing scattered spreadsheets.", icon: Table }, { title: "Automated Certificate Countdown", description: "Visual timeline ribbons showing expiring GFSI and HACCP certificates with automated escalation rules that lock procurement orders when certificates lapse.", icon: Clock }, { title: "Audit Non-Conformance Ticket Suite", description: "End-to-end query resolution interface linking conversation history, re-testing lab reports, and QA approval sign-offs in one immutable container.", icon: FileCheck }, { title: "Global Facility Switcher", description: "Enterprise hierarchy controls enabling directors to toggle between macro enterprise view and specific manufacturing plant receiving docks.", icon: Database } ]; export default function FoodSafety() { return (
{/* Navigation Breadcrumb */}
Back to Selected Work
{/* ===================================================== 1. PROJECT OVERVIEW & CONTEXT ====================================================== */}
CASE STUDY 03 · ENTERPRISE DASHBOARD & WORKFLOW DESIGN
PROFESSIONAL WORK · SMARTFOODSAFE ERP

Food Safety Compliance Dashboard

Designing an enterprise compliance system for QA and Food Safety directors—turning high-risk supply chain data, expiring certificates, and audit non-conformances into actionable workflows.

{/* Metadata Grid */}
Role UX/UI & Product Designer
Domain Enterprise ERP & Supply Chain
Focus Data Density & Audit Workflows
Platform Desktop Web Application
{/* Hero Visual Preview */}
FIG 1.0 · SUPPLIER COMPLIANCE MONITORING INTERFACE GFSI & HACCP Audit Tracking · Expiration Countdowns
{/* ===================================================== 2. PROBLEM STATEMENT ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("02 · PROBLEM DISCOVERY")}

When compliance data lives in silos, contamination risks multiply

In food manufacturing, a single expired supplier audit can cause millions of dollars in product recalls, federal penalties, and consumer health hazards.

QA teams were drowning in manual emails: suppliers sent renewal certificates as PDF attachments, receiving dock inspectors tracked lot numbers on clipboards, and plant managers had no real-time way to know if an incoming shipment complied with food safety standards.

Lapsed Certificate Blind Spots

Expired supplier certifications were often only discovered during third-party regulatory audits rather than in advance.

Disconnected Query Resolution

When an ingredient batch failed inspection, dispute communication was lost across email threads without an immutable audit trail.

{/* ===================================================== 3. TARGET USERS & RESEARCH INSIGHTS ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("03 · USER RESEARCH & STAKEHOLDERS")}

Stakeholder Mental Models Across the Supply Chain

{compliancePersonas.map((persona) => (
User Persona

{persona.role}

{persona.context}

Critical Need: {persona.need}
))}
{/* ===================================================== 4. INFORMATION ARCHITECTURE & KEY WORKFLOWS ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("04 · COMPLIANCE LIFECYCLE ARCHITECTURE")}

End-to-End Supplier Governance Flow

{complianceWorkflows.map((flow) => (
{flow.step}

{flow.title}

{flow.detail}

))}
{/* ===================================================== 5 & 6. KEY FEATURES & INTERFACE SOLUTIONS ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("05 & 06 · INTERFACE SOLUTIONS")}

Designed for High Data-Density & Immediate Action

{erpModules.map((module) => { const Icon = module.icon; return (

{module.title}

{module.description}

); })}
{/* ===================================================== 7. ENTERPRISE COMPLEXITY & REGULATORY COMPLIANCE ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("07 · DOMAIN COMPLEXITY")}

Adhering to GFSI, FSMA & HACCP Standards

Strict Immutable Audit Trails

FDA 21 CFR Part 11 mandates that any modifications to compliance certificates or audit scores must be cryptographically timestamped and attributed to authenticated user credentials. The UI surfaces this audit history in a non-intrusive side-panel.

Multi-Tenant Supplier Isolation

External ingredient vendors access a scoped supplier portal where they can only view and respond to their own queries, while internal enterprise QA officers manage cross-supplier benchmarking.

{/* ===================================================== 8 & 9. DESIGN SYSTEM & TECHNICAL FEASIBILITY ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("08 & 09 · DESIGN SYSTEM & CODE ARCHITECTURE")}

Component System & Frontend Implementation

Custom Data Table Component Specification

Designed sticky headers, sortable columns, and configurable column visibility drawers so QA officers can personalize their dashboard view based on current audit tasks.

Token-Driven Status Indicators

Standardized status pill design tokens (Compliant, Expiring Soon, Non-Conformance, Suspended) with high contrast text conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA standards.

{/* ===================================================== 10. IMPACT & NEXT PROJECT ====================================================== */}
{getSectionTag("10 · NEXT CASE STUDY")}

EduHire AI Learning App

AI-assisted learning pathways and mobile hiring UX.

View Next Case Study
); }
